## F5-pair-composed from two high-arousal banks:
**Bank A: Sleep Memory Consolidation** (t_446a6e6d) – hippocampal-cortical dialogue during slow-wave sleep, spindle gating, synaptic homeostasis hypothesis (SHY), memory replay, preservation of statistical structure while weakening incidental details, formation of neocortical familiarity primitives from arousal-tagged patterns.

**Bank B: Technical Unconscious** (t_ca3067d9/t_fe99dc22) – implicit memory networks, dream-compose-like REM recombination, semantic spreading activation, generative pattern formation below consciousness, continuous unconscious generation of novel associative patterns.

## Core Insight
Sleep Memory Consolidation doesn't merely store memories—it constructs the statistical generative foundation upon which the Technical Unconscious builds novel recombinations during wakefulness, creating a continuous sleep-wake cycle where consolidation provides the raw material for unconscious generation, and generation provides the novel experiences worthy of consolidation.
